edges.reason: Constructor stores _msgSender() (msg.sender) into _owner, which gates onlyOwner.
msg.sender flows in as the 'from' address of _transfer via transfer/transferFrom.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
transfer delegates all logic to internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the value movement to internal _transfer.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances[sender][msg.sender].
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth on the contract token balance before token accounting completes.
_transfer sends contract ETH to fee wallets before finishing the state update.
_transfer performs the actual balance accounting through _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
Cooldown branch enforces require(amount <= _maxTxAmount), tying input amount to a state limit.
require(!bots[from]) blacklist check consumes the bots mapping.
cooldownEnabled gates whether the max transaction check is applied.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap-and-send branch.
inSwap guard is read to prevent nested swaps, but the ETH payout still precedes accounting.
_transfer compares 'from' against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys/sells.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
swapTokensForEth calls and reads uniswapV2Router (WETH, swap).
sendETHToFee performs ETH .transfer to the fee wallets, an external call before the transfer completes.
sendETHToFee sends amount/3 to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee sends amount/3 to _feeAddrWallet2.
sendETHToFee sends amount/3 to _feeAddrWallet3.
openTrading performs the external addLiquidityETH call with min amounts 0.
openTrading writes the router address into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
openTrading uses owner() as the liquidity recipient.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 as its only authorization.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 as its only authorization.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract token balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the full contract ETH balance.
_transferStandard takes the team share via _takeTeam before reflecting the fee.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflected balances in _rOwned.
_transferStandard retrieves r/t amounts and fees from _getValues.
_takeTeam adds the reflected team share to _rOwned[address(this)].
_takeTeam obtains the current reflection rate from _getRate.
_reflectFee performs _rTotal = _rTotal.sub(rFee), a supply mutation.
_reflectFee performs _tFeeTotal = _tFeeTotal.add(tFee).
_getRate obtains rSupply and tSupply from _getCurrentSupply.
_getRate divides supplies derived from _rTotal to produce the rate.
_getCurrentSupply reads and divides _rTotal for its sanity comparison.
_getCurrentSupply compares and divides _tTotal.
_getValues fetches the current rate via _getRate.
tokenFromReflection uses _getRate to divide the reflected amount.
_getValues passes _feeAddr1 as the tax fee into _getTValues.
_getValues passes _feeAddr2 as the team fee into _getTValues.
_transfer sets _feeAddr1 = 1 before accounting.
_transfer sets _feeAddr2 = 10 before accounting.
setCooldownEnabled (onlyOwner) writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
liftMaxTx (onlyOwner) overwrites the _maxTxAmount limit.
renounceOwnership zeroes out the _owner state variable.
ETH payout to fee wallets can re-enter _transfer (state not yet finalized) before accounting.
Router swap callback can re-enter token transfer logic while inSwap bookkeeping is active.
addLiquidityETH external interaction can re-enter before tradingOpen/swapEnabled flags are finalized.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only carries the ERC20 value forwarded into _transfer.
The recipient parameter is a simple pass-through address for transfer.
The sender parameter only feeds the delegated _transfer and allowance decrement.
The currentRate local exists solely inside the _getRate rate computation.
The rSupply local exists solely inside _getCurrentSupply.
The tSupply local exists solely inside _getCurrentSupply.
The tTeam local is passed directly into _takeTeam for reflection credit.
The amount parameter is only used to split ETH among the three fee wallets.
